title: The Last Ticket and a Rainy Light Show
excerpt: I scored the very last ArtScience Museum ticket of the day, then abandoned my laksa mid-meal to watch the Supertrees light up to the Inside Out soundtrack — in the rain, grinning.

photos.alt: Purple water lilies blanketing a pond in front of the Marina Bay skyline and the Louis Vuitton island store on a partly cloudy afternoon
Interactive digital projection at ArtScience Museum showing colorful hand-drawn jellyfish, fish, and sea creatures floating in an animated underwater scene
Supertree Grove at Gardens by the Bay on a rainy overcast evening, with a brightly lit pink-and-purple carnival structure glowing among the towering metal trees
Large white sculpture of a floating infant reclining above a green garden bed at Gardens by the Bay, city skyscrapers visible in the background
Overhead view of a bowl of Singapore laksa — rich orange-red curry broth with whole prawns, a halved boiled egg, and fish cake, served in a Hawker Chan bowl
Animatronic T-rex roaring atop a rocky plinth inside Jurassic Food Hall at night, diners and food stalls visible beneath warm lighting in the background
Supertree Grove light show at night, the towering metal supertrees glowing vivid green against a dark sky with the Marina Bay Sands visible to the left
Multiple Apple AirPods charging cases in various models arranged in a loose circular pattern on a wooden display surface inside the Marina Bay Apple Store
Rain Oculus waterfall inside The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands — a column of water cascades from the circular glass oculus into a reflecting pool below, luxury retail shops lining the atrium
